doc.brief: The QTreeView class provides a default model/view implementation of a tree view.
doc.index_brief: Default model/view implementation of a tree view

QHeaderView * header() const.brief: Returns the header for the tree view.

QModelIndex indexAbove(const QModelIndex.brief: Returns the model index of the item above *index*.

QModelIndex indexBelow(const QModelIndex.brief: Returns the model index of the item below *index*.

QTreeView(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a tree view with a *parent* to represent a model's data.

bool allColumnsShowFocus() const.brief: This property holds whether items should show keyboard focus using all columns

bool expandsOnDoubleClick() const.brief: This property holds whether the items can be expanded by double-clicking.

bool isAnimated() const.brief: This property holds whether animations are enabled

bool isColumnHidden(int column) const.brief: Returns `true` if the *column* is hidden; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isExpanded(const QModelIndex &index.brief: Returns `true` if the model item *index* is expanded; otherwise returns false.

bool isFirstColumnSpanned(int row, const.brief: Returns `true` if the item in first column in the given *row* of the *parent* is spanning all the columns; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isHeaderHidden() const.brief: This property holds whether the header is shown or not.

bool isRowHidden(int row, const QModelIn.brief: Returns `true` if the item in the given *row* of the *parent* is hidden; otherwise returns `false`.

bool isSortingEnabled() const.brief: This property holds whether sorting is enabled

bool itemsExpandable() const.brief: This property holds whether the items are expandable by the user.

bool rootIsDecorated() const.brief: This property holds whether to show controls for expanding and collapsing top-level items

bool uniformRowHeights() const.brief: This property holds whether all items in the treeview have the same height

bool wordWrap() const.brief: This property holds the item text word-wrapping policy

int autoExpandDelay() const.brief: This property holds the delay time before items in a tree are opened during a drag and drop operation.

int columnAt(int x) const.brief: Returns the column in the tree view whose header covers the *x* coordinate given.

int columnViewportPosition(int column) c.brief: Returns the horizontal position of the *column* in the viewport.

int indentation() const.brief: indentation of the items in the tree view.

int indexRowSizeHint(const QModelIndex &.brief: Returns the size hint for the row indicated by *index*.

int rowHeight(const QModelIndex &index).brief: Returns the height of the row indicated by the given *index*.

int treePosition() const.brief: Return the logical index the tree is set on.

void collapse(const QModelIndex &index).brief: Collapses the model item specified by the *index*.

void collapsed(const QModelIndex &index).brief: This signal is emitted when the item specified by *index* is collapsed.

void columnCountChanged(int oldCount, in.brief: Informs the tree view that the number of columns in the tree view has changed from *oldCount* to *newCount*.

void columnMoved().brief: This slot is called whenever a column has been moved.

void columnResized(int column, int oldSi.brief: This function is called whenever *column*'s size is changed in the header. *oldSize* and *newSize* give the previous size and the new size in pixels.

void dataChanged(const QModelIndex &topL.brief: Reimplements: [QAbstractItemView::dataChanged](xref:qt:QAbstractItemView)(const QModelIndex &topLeft, const QModelIndex &bottomRight, const QList<int> &roles).

void drawBranches(QPainter *painter, con.brief: Draws the branches in the tree view on the same row as the model item *index*, using the *painter* given.

void drawRow(QPainter *painter, const QS.brief: Draws the row in the tree view that contains the model item *index*, using the *painter* given.

void drawTree(QPainter *painter, const Q.brief: Draws the part of the tree intersecting the given *region* using the specified *painter*.

void expand(const QModelIndex &index).brief: Expands the model item specified by the *index*.

void expandRecursively(const QModelIndex.brief: Expands the item at the given *index* and all its children to the given *depth*.

void expandToDepth(int depth).brief: Expands all expandable items to the given *depth*.

void expanded(const QModelIndex &index).brief: This signal is emitted when the item specified by *index* is expanded.

void resetIndentation().brief: indentation of the items in the tree view.

void resizeColumnToContents(int column).brief: Resizes the *column* given to the size of its contents.

void rowsAboutToBeRemoved(const QModelIn.brief: Reimplements: [QAbstractItemView::rowsAboutToBeRemoved](xref:qt:QAbstractItemView)(const QModelIndex &parent, int start, int end).

void rowsInserted(const QModelIndex &par.brief: Reimplements: [QAbstractItemView::rowsInserted](xref:qt:QAbstractItemView)(const QModelIndex &parent, int start, int end).

void rowsRemoved(const QModelIndex &pare.brief: Informs the view that the rows from the *start* row to the *end* row inclusive have been removed from the given *parent* model item.

void setAllColumnsShowFocus(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether items should show keyboard focus using all columns

void setAnimated(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether animations are enabled

void setAutoExpandDelay(int delay).brief: This property holds the delay time before items in a tree are opened during a drag and drop operation.

void setColumnHidden(int column, bool hi.brief: If *hide* is true the *column* is hidden, otherwise the *column* is shown.

void setColumnWidth(int column, int widt.brief: Sets the width of the given *column* to the *width* specified.

void setExpanded(const QModelIndex &inde.brief: Sets the item referred to by *index* to either collapse or expanded, depending on the value of *expanded*.

void setExpandsOnDoubleClick(bool enable.brief: This property holds whether the items can be expanded by double-clicking.

void setFirstColumnSpanned(int row, cons.brief: If *span* is true the item in the first column in the *row* with the given *parent* is set to span all columns, otherwise all items on the *row* are shown.

void setHeader(QHeaderView *header).brief: Sets the header for the tree view, to the given *header*.

void setHeaderHidden(bool hide).brief: This property holds whether the header is shown or not.

void setIndentation(int i).brief: indentation of the items in the tree view.

void setItemsExpandable(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether the items are expandable by the user.

void setRootIsDecorated(bool show).brief: This property holds whether to show controls for expanding and collapsing top-level items

void setRowHidden(int row, const QModelI.brief: If *hide* is true the *row* with the given *parent* is hidden, otherwise the *row* is shown.

void setSortingEnabled(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether sorting is enabled

void setTreePosition(int index).brief: This specifies that the tree structure should be placed at logical index *index*.

void setUniformRowHeights(bool uniform).brief: This property holds whether all items in the treeview have the same height

void setWordWrap(bool on).brief: This property holds the item text word-wrapping policy

void showColumn(int column).brief: Shows the given *column* in the tree view.

void sortByColumn(int column, Qt::SortOr.brief: Sorts the model by the values in the given *column* and *order*.
